content: sqlite3 legacy transaction control: isolation_level accepts 'DEFERRED' (default, '' alias), 'IMMEDIATE', 'EXCLUSIVE', or None (no implicit transactions). Implicit transactions open ONLY before INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/REPLACE (never SELECT/DDL); the implicit BEGIN kind follows isolation_level, so isolation_level='IMMEDIATE' makes every implicit write transaction BEGIN IMMEDIATE. 'with conn:' commits on success/rolls back on exception and does nothing when no transaction is open — works unchanged under any isolation_level value. Locally verified on Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 via probes (commit/rollback preserved under IMMEDIATE; second writer honors busy_timeout). Python 3.12 added conn.autocommit (LEGACY_TRANSACTION_CONTROL default); SIF targets 3.10 so isolation_level is the correct knob.
